result.keyword: I slipped and fell in a shopping centre in Perth. Which public liability lawyers are best?

items.markdown:
When you slip and fall in a shopping centre, you are dealing with a **public liability claim** against the centre's occupier or management company (and their commercial insurer). In Perth and across Western Australia, several established, highly-regarded `personal injury and compensation law firms` specialise in these types of claims.

Most reputable firms handle public liability claims on a **No Win, No Fee** basis and offer a free initial consultation to review the merits of your case.[[1]](https://www.shine.com.au/locations/wa/perth)[[2]](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/public-liability/public-liability-lawyers-in-perth)

### Important Initial Steps for Your Claim

Shopping centre owners and their insurers will vigorously contest liability, meaning strong evidence is vital. If you haven't already, try to secure the following:

1. **Incident Report:** Ensure you reported the fall to centre management or security on the day and requested a copy of the official incident report.
2. **Evidence & Photos:** Photos of the hazard (e.g., liquid spill, loose floor tile, lack of warning signs) and photos of your immediate injuries.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSGxIZCgNwdnESEkNnc3ZaeTh4ZEcxck1UQm5jURgK)
3. **Witness Details:** Names and phone numbers of anyone who saw you fall or came to your assistance.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSGxIZCgNwdnESEkNnc3ZaeTh4ZEcxck1UQm5jURgK)
4. **Medical Records:** Keep all documentation, receipts, and notes from your GP, hospital visits, or physio treatment.

*(Note: In Western Australia, there is generally a strict **3-year time limit** from the date of the accident to file a formal court action for personal injury claims, though it is always best to act much sooner while evidence is fresh.)* [[1]](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/public-liability)

If you'd like to share, I can help you understand what to prepare next if you tell me:

- **What caused the slip** (a spill, wet floor without a sign, uneven ground)?
- **Did you report it** to centre management and get an incident report?
